segments.caption: An island fortress across the sea. Its king has ten heads, and a stolen queen.
segments.vo: An island fortress across the sea. Its king has ten heads, and a stolen queen.

segments.caption: On the shore, an army of monkeys builds a bridge of floating stones.
segments.vo: On the shore, an army of monkeys builds a bridge of floating stones.

segments.caption: They follow one man. A prince without a kingdom.
segments.vo: They follow one man. A prince without a kingdom.

segments.caption: Years earlier, Rama was heir to the throne of Ayodhya.
segments.vo: Years earlier, Rama was heir to the throne of Ayodhya.

segments.caption: He won Princess Sita by lifting a bow no other suitor could move, and it snapped in two.
segments.vo: He won Princess Sita by lifting a bow no other suitor could move, and it snapped in two.

segments.caption: But on the eve of his crowning, Queen Kaikeyi called in two old promises.
segments.vo: But on the eve of his crowning, Queen Kaikeyee called in two old promises.

segments.caption: Her son would rule. Rama would live in the forest for fourteen years.
segments.vo: Her son would rule. Rama would live in the forest for fourteen years.

segments.caption: He went without a word of protest, with Sita and his brother Lakshmana.
segments.vo: He went without a word of protest, with Sita and his brother Lakshmana.

segments.caption: Deep in the forest, a golden deer lured Rama away.
segments.vo: Deep in the forest, a golden deer lured Rama away.

segments.caption: Ravana came dressed as a holy man, and carried Sita off through the sky.
segments.vo: Raavan came dressed as a holy man, and carried Sita off through the sky.

segments.caption: An old vulture, Jatayu, flew up to stop him, and fell.
segments.vo: An old vulture, Jataayu, flew up to stop him, and fell.

segments.caption: Searching the south, Rama found allies in the monkey king Sugriva and his minister, Hanuman.
segments.vo: Searching the south, Rama found allies in the monkey king Sugreeva and his minister, Hanuman.

segments.caption: Hanuman leapt the sea, found Sita, and left Lanka burning.
segments.vo: Hanuman leapt the sea, found Sita, and left Lanka burning.

segments.caption: Then the army built its bridge. And crossed.
segments.vo: Then the army built its bridge. And crossed.

segments.caption: The war ended with one arrow, and Ravana fell.
segments.vo: The war ended with one arrow, and Raavan fell.

segments.caption: Rama came home to Ayodhya, and the city lit lamps to greet him.
segments.vo: Rama came home to Ayodhya, and the city lit lamps to greet him.

segments.caption: Every autumn, at Diwali, millions still light them.
segments.vo: Every autumn, at Diwali, millions still light them.

segments.caption: The poet Valmiki told it in about twenty-four thousand verses.
segments.vo: The poet Vaalmiki told it in about twenty-four thousand verses.

segments.caption: More than two thousand years on, it is still being told.
segments.vo: More than two thousand years on, it is still being told.
